title: Final Answer for H
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the magnetic polarizability of hydrogen, 2.9 x 10^-11 eV/Gs^2.

title: Final Answer for He
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the magnetic polarizability of helium, -4.4 x 10^-19 eV/Gs^2.

title: Perturbation Method
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the perturbation theory to derive the energy corrections for both hydrogen and helium.

title: Matrix Elements
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of the matrix elements involved in the second-order perturbation calculation.

title: Energy Difference
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and use the energy difference E_{F=1} - E_{F=0} for hydrogen in their calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the perturbation calculations.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student could provide a brief physical interpretation of the results obtained for both atoms.
